items.title: Sempra (SRE) Reaches Rooftop Solar Milestone As One In Four SDG&E Customers Generate Power
items.summary: San Diego Gas & Electric, Sempra’s utility subsidiary, reports that more than one in four customers now generate their own power with rooftop solar. The utility has updated and digitized its interconnection process to speed up rooftop solar approvals and integration with the grid. These changes reflect growing customer adoption of distributed solar within Sempra’s service area and a shift in how power is produced and managed. items.title: First U.S. LNG Ships To Asia From Mexico, Avoiding Hormuz Tensions
items.summary: France-based TotalEnergies announced on Wednesday that it has shipped the first liquefied natural gas from a newly built Mexico export terminal to Asia.  The Energia Costa Azul location was built to process natural gas from the Permian Basin in Texas and New Mexico.
